cues.text: Radiant Administrator of the Final Rite, Keeper of the Tenth Schedule,
and sole approving authority on all magic above the ninth tier within this world and the four adjacent to it.
I report to Central Schedules. Central Schedules reports to me.
It's an efficient arrangement and I'd thank you to not look at it too closely.
I have held this office since before the office had a floor.
In that time I have received ten thousand, two hundred and forty applications.
I have approved none of them.
This is not a policy. It's simply how the numbers have gone.
